notes: 8 configurations, 5 manufacturers (LACO Technologies, Dynavac/Weiss Technik, Sunpower/AMETEK, IRLabs, kiutra). Absences use install=not_available with value kind unknown, following existing catalog files; cryogen-free machines carry cryogen.type as the empty set. Magnet absences for TVAC chambers and dewars rest on the complete specification / component lists (no magnet appears), not on marketing silence; reviewers may treat these as the weakest absences. Single stated operating temperatures (LACO 18x24 -150 C; IRLabs HDL-8 4.2 K; ND-8 77 K; LACO shroud -150 C) are stored as lo = hi per the vocabulary rule. Sunpower lift values are nominal (no guaranteed value published); cold-tip diameter used as sample.diameter.max per family_mapping; sample.height.max, vacuum.available and pressure.base are not_available because the user must supply the cryostat. Thales LPT9310 and HPD/FormFactor ADRs were considered but no readable manufacturer datasheet was reachable (search quota exhausted on Tavily; formfactor.com blocks scripted access). Not found: kiutra temperature.range and pressure.base; LACO 36x40 electrical.sample_connections.
